name: Corrupted Songflower
objectiveText: Progress You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a songflower plant.  A pungent, unhealthy odor emanates from the plant.  It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal. Cenarion Plant Salve  ( 2 )

comments.body: you havta do the cleansing felwood quest first...then you get to clean these plants

Using a [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=11516/cenarion-plant-salve]salve[/url] on this will spawn a [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/object=164882/cleansed-songflower]cleansed version[/url] that, when opened provides [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=15366/songflower-serenade]this[/url]
I made a compilation of all the spawn locations here: https://imgur.com/a/g0yXnrq

/way Felwood 64, 6
/way Felwood 50, 13
/way Felwood 63, 22
/way Felwood 40, 44
/way Felwood 34, 52
/way Felwood 40, 56
/way Felwood 48, 75
/way Felwood 56, 85
/way Felwood 53, 88
After the flower is cleansed you can click on it to get an hour buff called "Songflower Serenade" that increases the chance to crit by 5% and adds 15 to all stats.

If you have a choice of which flower to 'uncorrupt', choose this one. 

It adds 15 to all of your stats for one hour. 

True, with the others you get more items; but, this lasts longer (vs taking one of the others) than the others' 10 minutes. 

It helps you slice through the satyrs like buttah.  :)
That's all fantastic and luvverly, but where is it?

This quest is broken for now. If you inhale the songflower you will not get the stat buff and the crit increase. You will get a message that "the songflower was resisted".
A GM told me that it is broken and they are looking into it. Hopefully next patch will fix that.
anyone have any locations for any of the corrupted plants or are they a random spawn?
replies:

Link above your post gives locations. I've verified some of them, but I can't guarantee 100% accuracy though.
